acceptance: A batch that runs from a linked worktree with no root named reads the stop of the project, or prints one warning that names the fallback
A journey test through runIntegration pins it, and it fails before the change
fix: Resolve the root from the common git directory of the working directory, or print one warning when the root came from the working-directory fallback. Pin it with a journey that runs the batch from a linked worktree while a stop holds.

intake_override.reason: the code of the item is in pull request 1397, which is not on main, so a lane on main cannot build it

summary: evolve integration batch (ADR-0165 G4c, PR #1397) reads the main-red stop from --project-root, then EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT, then the working directory. From a linked worktree with no root named it finds no main-red-stop.json, so the batch lands at enforce with no line on stderr. gates.main_red_stop must not move to enforce before this is fixed.
title: The integration batch warns or resolves its root when it reads the main-red stop from the working directory
